description: This file declares exported API functions for a Web General Session Object, defining creation, removal, and initialization functions relevant to the Web server subsystem.

methods.name: WebCreateGeneralSession
methods.description: Creates a new Web General Session object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: WebGsoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of Web General Session object.

methods.name: WebGsoRemove
methods.description: Removes a Web General Session object.

methods.name: WebGsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Web General Session context.

methods.name: WebGsoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Web General Session object.
